BDR Setup Loader 1.0.12

New in this version:
- Download preset: the download button now gives the game's own preset file (for example "BDR - Pro Mod 10 - Pro Mod Blower (1) - Clutch - 5.225.json"). Put it in Documents\BountyDragRacing\Tunes before you start the game, then pick it in the preset list of the tuning menu.
- Download all as ZIP on the Saved page now holds these preset files. Unzip it into Documents\BountyDragRacing\Tunes.

Installed apps update themselves via the button in the top bar. For a fresh install, close the game and the Setup Loader, start `BDR-Setup-Loader-Installer-1.0.12.exe` and click Install.
